tagline: A directory for your contacts, on your own server.
title: Open your address book
lede: Natel reads and edits your contacts directly on your CardDAV server.
insecure: This connection isn’t encrypted: your password can be read on the network.
privacy: Your password is only ever sent to your server, which keeps it in memory while your session is open.
err_connection_body: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact whoever runs this Natel.
sync_failed_body: The contacts shown may be out of date.
empty_hint: Search also covers numbers, emails and organisations.
no_books: No address books found on this server.
contact_not_found_body: This contact is not in this address book.
shortcut_escape: Cancel, close or clear the search
field_adr_empty: Fill in the address under this label
err_save_network: Network error: the change may have been saved anyway.
err_delete_network: Network error: the contact may have been deleted anyway.
err_save_timeout: The server didn’t answer in time: the change may have been saved anyway.
err_delete_timeout: The server didn’t answer in time: the contact may have been deleted anyway.
err_save_too_large: The server refused this card for its size ({size}). Its request size limit can be raised.
err_save_maybe_too_large: The connection dropped while sending this card ({size}). The server may have refused it for its size, in which case its request size limit can be raised. Otherwise, try again.
err_create_exists: This contact already exists on the server, probably saved by an earlier attempt. Reload the list before trying again.
conflict_delete_hint: Reload it to see the changes before deleting it.
import_reason_duplicate: same UID as an earlier card in the file
import_reason_conflict: a card with this UID was added elsewhere; reload, then import again
import_reason_network: network error; it may have been added anyway
import_reason_timeout: no answer from the server in time; it may have been added anyway
import_reason_too_large: too large for the server; its size limit can be raised
import_reason_maybe_too_large: the connection dropped while sending it; it may be too large for the server
import_failed_generic: Import failed. Try again in a moment.
export_incomplete: Export failed: some cards couldn’t be fetched ({n}). Nothing was saved.
export_failed: Export failed. Try again in a moment.
move_disabled_hint: Save or cancel your changes first.
conflict_move_hint: Reload it to see the changes before moving it.
err_move_timeout: The server didn’t answer in time: nothing was moved.
err_move_unexpected: The server refused the move: nothing was moved.
err_move_exists: A card with this contact’s UID is already in the target address book, maybe from an earlier move. Nothing was moved.
err_move_create_uncertain: The contact may have been copied to the target address book, and was not removed from this one. Both books were reloaded.
err_move_delete_uncertain: The contact was copied to the target address book and may still be in this one. Both books were reloaded.
err_move_in_both: The contact may now be in both address books. Both books were reloaded.
groups_not_saved: The contact was saved, but these groups were not updated:
group_err_network: network error; it may have been updated anyway
group_err_timeout: no answer from the server in time; it may have been updated anyway
photo_frame_hint: Drag to move the photo, pinch or scroll to zoom. With the keyboard: the arrow keys move it, + and − zoom.
photo_err_undecodable: This image can’t be read. Choose another one.
photo_err_encode: This browser couldn’t prepare the photo. Try again, or choose another image.
demo_notice: Demo: nothing is saved, change anything you like.
demo_login: Demo: any username and password work. Nothing is saved.
privacy_demo: In this demo, nothing you type leaves your browser.
delete_body: It will be deleted from the server, and so from all your synced devices.
field_name_required: Enter a last name, a first name or an organisation.
book_empty_hint: Add a first contact, or import those of another address book.
load_failed_body: The contacts server isn’t answering. Try again in a moment.
sign_out_failed: Couldn’t sign out: check the connection and try again.
session_expired_body: Sign in again to get back to your contacts.
unshown_body: Natel doesn’t show these details of the card yet. Every save keeps them as they are.
book_incomplete_body: The list is incomplete. Retry or check the cards with another CardDAV client.
